name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 7 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 1.61 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
